author: Shemistan
quote: If this game had been developed by a Western studio, I genuinely believe its review scores would be much higher. This is the absolute RPG. That's the only way I can describe it. It has everything you'd want from an RPG and then some: a gigantic open world that never feels empty, fully explorable underwater environments (especially with the DLC), incredible boss fights, and an unbelievable amount of **** game lets you approach the world and your adventure however you want, constantly rewarding exploration and curiosity. It captures the kind of freedom and sense of discovery that made Skyrim so special, while offering an enormous world of its own to get lost **** you love RPGs that give you the freedom to explore, experiment, and make your own adventure, this is an absolute must-play. The ultimate RPG experience.

author: Shemistan
quote: This game deserves its own genre: French RPG (F-RPG). It's easily one of the best turn-based RPGs I've ever played. I've played my fair share of turn-based RPGs, but the combat in this one is something special. It combines traditional turn-based combat with Soulslike elements, introducing real-time parrying, dodging, and perfectly timed defensive actions into the turn-based formula. It's an unusual combination, but the execution is nothing short of brilliant. It makes every encounter feel engaging and rewards skill, timing, and precision rather than relying solely on stats and **** story, voice acting, animations, and cinematics are all exceptional. What really makes the game stand out, though, is its characters. They feel like real people rather than one-dimensional stereotypes or characters created simply to tick a box. Each has their own personality, history, and emotions, and you can genuinely feel the depth behind **** story also has plenty of surprises along the way, keeping you invested until the very end. An absolute masterpiece and a must-play.

author: Shemistan
quote: The best game of all time. The level of freedom this game offers is truly unmatched. You can approach almost any situation however you like, and the game genuinely adapts to your actions. Kill someone, save them, take an item or leave it behind; even the smallest decisions can have consequences that come back to surprise you hours later. It's not just about giving players the freedom to make their own choices, but about making those choices genuinely matter. That's what makes this game a masterpiece.

author: Shemistan
quote: I've waited 13 years for a dating sim that runs at 13 FPS. If I wanted a relationship simulator, there are plenty of dating sims out there with better stories than this. I play games to have fun, not to deal with chores and toxic relationships. Gaming is supposed to be an escape from all that.I was already worried about GTA 6's story after all the changes to the development team and writers over the years, but man, I didn't expect it to be this **** sandbox itself is good, but the constant restrictions kill the fun. You can't steal this car, you can't kill that NPC, you can't run over certain people, and you can't even use your gun in certain areas. What's the point of having an open world if the game keeps taking away your freedom?Honestly, go play any random dating sim. You'll probably get a better story, better performance, and save yourself $100.

author: Shemistan
quote: The best game of all time. Even today, in 2026, it still manages to pull you in completely, making you forget how old it actually is. The remake might be more polished by today's standards, but there's something special about the original that simply cannot be replicated. Its innovation and ambition were way ahead of its time. An absolute masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Shemistan
quote: An incredibly vast open world with an unparalleled sense of exploration. Whenever you spot something interesting in the distance and decide to head towards it, there's always something waiting to be discovered. The world constantly rewards your curiosity and makes exploration feel exciting and meaningful. If I had to pick a single game for exploration and adventure, this would be it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

quote: One of the best remakes of all time. It manages to preserve the original game while modernizing it in all the right ways. It captures the nostalgia and charm of the original while getting rid of the outdated mechanics and inconveniences. A perfect balance between staying true to its roots and bringing the experience up to modern standards.
